policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders a plural: 'none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered'. The qere צִדְקֹתָיו is plural ('his righteousnesses'); the ketiv צדקתו is singular. The plural English noun distinguishes the qere. The two chapter notes here are classed alternative_rendering ('Or, for', 'Or, for it') and bear on the rendering of the following clause, not on this lemma.

ASV renders a plural: 'None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him'. The qere חַטֹּאתָיו is plural ('his sins'); the ketiv חטאתו is singular. The plural English noun, with the plural relative clause, distinguishes the qere. No note is mapped to this unit.
